title: Chat Mode vs Agent Mode
brief: Route 10 Meridian questions to Chat or Agent mode, with a one-line justification each.
Two of the ten are research questions disguised as metric questions: the phrasing names
a single measure, but answering usefully needs several. Spotting those is the point.
Remember that Agent mode costs more, because it runs many queries per question. Routing
everything there is not a safe default; it is an expensive one.
review: Exactly two are identified as research questions in metric clothing.
Each justification says what the answer needs, not which mode sounds better.
At least one is routed to Chat specifically because Agent mode would cost more for no gain.

inputs.title: Ten questions to route — Chat mode or Agent mode
rows: 2. "Why did net flows fall in FY2026 Q3?"
4. "What was AUM by asset class last quarter?"
5. "Which segments are growing and which are shrinking, and what explains it?"
7. "Give me a picture of how the West region is performing."
8. "What is the average account value for Affluent clients?"
9. "Summarise what changed in the book over the last two quarters."
10. "What was net-of-fees TWR by strategy for the year to 30 June 2026?"
Two of these name a single measure but need several to answer usefully.
Number 5 and number 7 look like metric questions and are not.
Remember Agent mode runs many queries per question, so it costs more. Routing
everything there is not a safe default.
